name: Dead River
text: The river smells wrong. Someone tried to clean this once. Plastic and rust float where fish used to be.

name: Toxic Pipe
text: A pipe weeps green into the gutter. The metal is warm. You do not remember installing it.

name: Dying Tree
text: One leaf clings to a branch. Roots crack through asphalt — patient, stubborn, late.

name: Water Purifier
text: A purifier hums in half-sleep. Filters choked with sludge. The manual is gone.

name: Broken Drone
text: Wings folded like a dead insect. Its lens still blinks — recording nothing, remembering everything.

name: Abandoned Terminal
text: Screens dark. One line pulses: RESTORATION PROTOCOL — INCOMPLETE.

name: Garbage Mountain
text: Towers of bags and wire. The smell is a history lesson nobody wanted.

name: Broken Streetlights
text: Lamps hang like broken teeth. Cables stripped. The block hasn't seen light in years.

name: Warning Sign
text: TOXIC — DO NOT ENTER. The paint peels. Someone crossed it out with: TOO LATE.

name: Memory Fragment
text: A shard of glass catches your reflection. For a moment you are metal beneath skin.

name: The Center
text: You stand where the city forgot its name. The air waits. Something in you was built for this.

name: Ruined Fountain
text: Water stains the stone. Coins rust at the bottom. Someone wished here once.

name: Cracked Billboard
text: A smiling family sells air filters. The paint flakes into the wind.

name: Old Journal
text: Pages stick together. Entry dated the year the river turned.

name: Broken TV
text: Static hisses. A loop of green fields — stock footage from before.

name: Forgotten Home
text: Door unlocked. Photos face down. Dinner still set, grey with dust.

name: Air Filtration
text: Tower fans seized. Filters black. The city choked on its own breath.

name: Abandoned Factory
text: Conveyor belts stopped mid-shift. Chemical drums leak in slow motion.
